verdict.rationale: Marketing copy claims Justworks lets founders 'onboard international employees and contractors without the legal complexity of setting up an entity' and 'pay employees and contractors in multiple states or countries,' suggesting an EOR-style global hiring capability. However, there is no detailed documentation on which countries are covered, how the EOR relationship is structured, compliance specifics, or pricing for this service — the help center content is entirely US PEO/payroll/integration focused. Missing for 10: country coverage list, EOR process/compliance documentation, pricing details, and any independent or hands-on verification of international employment functioning.
